dataset: DeepSeti Dataset V2 - GBT Fine HDF5 S-band (provisional), frozen split

independence_rule.split_unit: group = connected component of inferred session folders and the ON (A) targets of their inferred ABACAD-like cadences
hard: no ON target in more than one split
no inferred session/cadence in more than one split
independence_rule.soft: off-target identity overlap minimised (not excluded) and reported

selection_procedure: Eligible cadence: every file passed audit filters; no file with an unavailable/failed header read; no header-verified geometry mismatch.
Per group, eligible cadences are ranked by a seeded shuffle (Random('<seed>:cadence-rank:<group>')).
Groups are visited in seeded order; the primary cadence is the first ranked cadence whose UTC observing day is not yet used (else the first).
Groups are sorted by (year, pipeline, seeded key) and allocated {'train': 60, 'validation': 15, 'test': 15} + reserve with a largest-deficit systematic rule.
50000 seeded same-stratum label swaps; a swap is kept only if it strictly lowers (cross-split target count, cross-split day count).
No signal content, RFI cleanliness, anomaly score or model result used.

geometry.rule: Every selected file must be individually header-verified before extraction; files without 16 usable integrations are excluded from the final manifest.

fallback_rule: If any file of a primary cadence fails individual header verification (unavailable, or not ~2.794 Hz / ~18.2536 s / 16 integrations), replace that cadence with the next alternate cadence of the SAME group (same split). If a group has no passing alternate, replace the group with the first reserve group (in listed order) that passes and introduces no ON-target or session leakage; record every replacement.
limitations: Session, cadence and group IDs are inferred, not archive-native.
S-band membership is provisional (receiver not exposed by the archive).
Quality is 'Ungraded' for all files; Grade A was not available.
Most files are not yet header-verified (geometry_status records this).
The 2300-2360 MHz region is not removed here; it is a predefined frame-level mask for extraction.
